### PowerPoint - July 14, 2010
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-july-14-2010-11634718.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 18:18
Points:
- David showed genuine humility when Saul offered him the chance to marry into the royal family.
- Even after defeating Goliath and gaining national fame, David did not let success change his character.
- Believers must resist an attitude of entitlement and remember that everything received is by God's mercy.
- When Christians continually give God the glory for their triumphs, He leads them from victory to victory.

### Day 23: 1 Samuel 18:17–30
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-23-1-samuel-18-1730.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 18:17-30
Points:
- Saul's escalating envy demonstrates the corrupting and destructive nature of unholy jealousy.
- David displayed godly restraint rather than using Saul's marriage offer for selfish social climbing.
- Saul's bitter hatred led him to treat his own daughter as bait in a murderous plot against David.
- While Saul plotted David's downfall through the Philistines, God protected David and frustrated the king's schemes.
- God's faithful presence with His servants far exceeds any human enemy's malicious plans.
